cluster_decision.framing_hypothesis_comparison: Overrode limpeza-energetica: the opportunity is specifically about the life-event of moving house, an occasion cluster distinct from the general home-purification theme.
cluster_decision.justification: Three cross-platform OBSERVED signals all frame the music around the moving-in occasion, not general cleansing; the occasion has its own audience, timing and content shape.

new_cluster_proposal.concept: Music for the specific life-event of moving into a new home: the first days, settling rituals, welcoming a space.

boundary_vs_adjacent.limpeza-energetica: General home purification is ongoing and not tied to an event; this cluster is bounded by the move itself.
boundary_vs_adjacent.cura-bem-estar: Not about recovery or restoration of a person; about a place and an occasion.
boundary_vs_adjacent.meditacao-relaxamento: Not a daily practice; a one-off occasion ritual.

new_cluster_proposal.why_not_subcluster: The moving-in occasion cuts across cleansing, welcome, organization and superstition; it is an occasion, not a purification sub-theme, so it does not sit cleanly under Limpeza Energetica.

strategic_definition.central_concept: Music that accompanies the move into a new home.
strategic_definition.audience_description: es-speaking people in the weeks around a house move.
strategic_definition.emotional_state: A fresh start and a sense of welcome in a new space.
strategic_definition.editorial_promise: A calm soundtrack for settling into your new home.
strategic_definition.positioning_statement: For es movers who want a calm settling-in soundtrack, this is occasion music for the move itself.
strategic_definition.localization_notes: es-native; the moving ritual is culturally salient across hispanohablante markets.
strategic_definition.durability_read: STRUCTURAL — moving house is a recurring life event.
strategic_definition.strategic_coherence_note: Extends the portfolio into occasion-based demand, adjacent to Limpeza Energetica.

content_direction.first_content_direction: A short video of a settling-in moment with the music underneath.
content_direction.music_relationship: Ambient bed under a domestic moment; sonic criteria are NEEDS_INPUT.
